notes.title: Pink Noise! Join the Kickstarter company
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone!

I’d like to recommend checking out Pink Noise. It's a psychological horror visual novel created by my friend. The game has launched a Kickstarter campaign, and now is the perfect time to support it!

Here’s why you should take a look:

🔸 Exclusive rewards: a digital artbook, soundtrack, and even the chance to leave your mark in the game.
🔸 Physical merch: posters, stickers, and T-shirts available only through this campaign.
🔸 Community & behind the scenes: the team shares updates and answers questions throughout the campaign.

The campaign has already reached over 20% of its goal and will run for another 28 days. Every bit of support helps bring this indie project closer to release.

👉 Kickstarter: [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pink-noise/pink-noise-0"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pink-noise/pink-noise-0[/url]
[/p][p]Here is [url="https://youtu.be/3Rs6F9tKv38?si=rY9nOuXX7tiWhrEA"]teaser[/url].[/p][p]
If you love story-driven games, horror, or indie projects, this is definitely worth supporting.

Let’s help bring Pink Noise to life together![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: About the upcoming release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

If you enjoyed [b]Children of the Sun[/b], it would be great if you left a review—this helps promotion a lot.

No DLC releases are planned. [b]Children of the Sun[/b] is a fully finished story that I’m not intending to expand.

At the beginning of July: «[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413920/Legends_of_Savvarah_Flowers_and_Scorpions/?curator_clanid=45559644]Legends of Savvarah: Flowers and Scorpions[/url][/b]» is scheduled for release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444543/c0b5f82196e76efe9e32d5fb2c85b72eeb345e00.jpg[/img]

You’ll return to the world of Savvarah, but the location, characters, and plot are completely different.

Our main heroine is a militant member of the cult of the god Dadar, sent as a spy to foreign lands.

This is a short game—more compact and local than Children of the Sun. It will feature 11 endings and three main characters with whom relationships beyond friendship are possible, though the game itself is not romance-focused.

notes.title: Plans and Bonuses
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

A few words about the initial results, upcoming plans, and a bit of bonus material.

By the way, you can find more detailed information on everything in my [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/legendsofsavvarah/]redditl[/url].

[b]1. Preliminary Results.[/b]

I think it’s safe to call it a failure, since the current performance is worse than my already unoptimistic forecasts. Does this affect the release of the next projects? Well, not really.

But if you enjoyed the game, it would be great if you could leave a review.

[b]2. Plans.
[/b]
The next project, which will be released this year, is "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413920/Legends_of_Savvarah_Flowers_and_Scorpions/]Legends of Savvarah: Flowers and Scorpions[/url]".

You can add it to your wishlist.

[b]3. Bonus.[/b]

As a bonus, I wanted to show you how the characters were created.
